drawings.description: marge gauche, en haut : un carré dont l'arête inférieure $a$ et l'arête supérieure $a'$ sont épaissies, le sommet $s$ en bas à gauche (gros point) et le sommet $s'$ en haut à droite, et la diagonale $d$ tracée de $s$ à $s'$.
drawings.kind: square with two heavy edges and a diagonal (frame of the cube on a face)
drawings.notes: As on the page: the square, its lower edge a and its upper edge a' heavy, the two other sides lighter, the diagonal d from s (lower left, heavy point) to s' (upper right), the five letters where he wrote them. All edges and the diagonal are drawn between the same four vertices. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: marge gauche, en bas : un carré dont les deux côtés horizontaux, épaissis, portent chacun la marque $c$, et en pointillé l'axe vertical qui les coupe en leur milieu, prolongé au-dessus et au-dessous du carré.
drawings.kind: square with two heavy opposite sides and its transverse axis (dashed)
drawings.notes: As on the page: the square, its upper and lower sides heavy and each marked c (the letter sits just above the side), the two vertical sides thin, and the dashed axis, slightly slanted, which crosses the two heavy sides near their middle and runs beyond the square above and below (down to the edge of the sheet). Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en bas, à droite de la précédente : un carré en pointillé dont la diagonale montante, prolongée en pointillé au-delà des deux sommets, porte la marque $d$ à chacun de ces sommets.
drawings.kind: dashed square with its diagonal produced
drawings.notes: The dashed square and its rising diagonal, drawn dashed through the lower left and the upper right vertices and produced beyond both (the outer end at the lower left is a full stroke on the page; drawn dashed with the rest); the letter d at each of the two vertices. Left out: a small heavy mark written against the lower left d (a cross or a k over the vertex: not read). Still differs: that mark. The words of the text that run into the crop at the top are not part of the figure. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: marge gauche, en haut : un carré en pointillé dont le côté droit, plein, est marqué $a$, avec le sommet $s$ (gros point) à son extrémité inférieure, et une flèche courbe tournant autour de son extrémité supérieure.
drawings.kind: dashed square with one full side and a curved arrow (rotation)
drawings.notes: As on the page: the square dashed on three sides, its right side full and marked a, the heavy point s at the lower end of that side, and the curved arrow that starts at the right of the side and turns over its upper end, head pointing left. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: marge gauche, en bas : un carré de sommets $s'$ (en haut à gauche) et $s$ (en haut à droite, gros point), l'arête supérieure $a$ épaissie, l'arête droite marquée $a'$ ; au-dessus, une flèche droite allant de droite à gauche et une flèche courbe descendant à droite de $s$ ; un mot biffé au-dessus des flèches.
drawings.kind: square with a heavy edge and two arrows (the two opposite rotations)
drawings.notes: As on the page: the square, its upper edge a heavy, from s' (upper left) to s (upper right, heavy point), the right edge marked a'; above it a straight arrow pointing left, and from the same place a curved arrow that goes down at the right of s. Left out: the struck word above the arrows (not drawn, as struck material). Disagreement in part with the note of the transcription, which speaks of one curved arrow above s: the page has two arrows, one straight to the left (s to s') and one curved downwards (a to a'). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says « une flèche courbe au-dessus de s »; the page has two arrows: a straight one pointing left above the edge a, and a curved one going down at the right of s.

drawings.description: tableau (40), première colonne : un cube en perspective dont les huit sommets sont marqués alternativement d'un point plein et d'un petit cercle (les sommets des deux tétraèdres inscrits).
drawings.kind: cube with vertices marked alternately full and open
drawings.notes: The cube in perspective, twelve edges drawn between the eight vertices, each vertex full or open as on the page: front face (lower left of the picture) upper left full, upper right open, lower right full, lower left open; back face upper left open, upper right full, lower right open, lower left full; so every edge joins a full vertex to an open one. The edges of the back face that are hidden (the lower one and the left one) are drawn dashed, as he broke them. The ring of the back lower right vertex is partly filled with ink on the page: read open, as the alternation requires. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: tableau (40), première colonne, sous le cube : un octaèdre en perspective dont deux des quatre faces visibles, opposées par le sommet central, sont hachurées (les deux couleurs des faces, en damier).
drawings.notes: The octahedron seen from the front: five visible vertices (top, right, left, bottom and the one facing the reader, in the middle) and the eight edges between them, all drawn between the same points; of the four visible faces, the upper left one (top, left, middle) and the lower right one (middle, right, bottom) are hatched. Still differs: his hatching is free strokes, horizontal in the upper left face and oblique in the lower right one, and overruns the edges; here both faces carry the same regular hatching. A faint stroke from the upper edge to the right vertex, inside the upper right face, is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sous la première ligne, un croquis : un axe vertical et un axe horizontal se coupant à l'origine ; au-dessus, une horizontale portant les trois points marqués $\xi_1$, $\xi_3$, $\xi_2$ (de gauche à droite) ; trois droites issues de l'origine passent par ces points et sont prolongées des deux côtés.
drawings.kind: three lines through the origin and three marked points on a horizontal
drawings.notes: As on the page: the short vertical axis and the horizontal axis through the origin (two small ticks on the latter), the horizontal line above carrying the three marked points, labelled xi_1, xi_3, xi_2 from left to right, and the three lines through the origin and these points; the three lines and the two axes are drawn through one computed origin, each line through its marked point, produced on both sides as far as he drew them (the line of xi_1 is gone over several times on the page: drawn once). Left out: the arrow, the sign infinity and the letter t at the top left of the crop, which belong to the first line of the text. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
